notes.title: Developer Update - October 15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/932b423c402dd1eebaad78e6cf298c1c54ccc772.png[/img]

We've talked much recently about the amazing Test Pilots within the Project Genesis community in the past, but we're excited to give you a little insight into the dedicated efforts they've been helping our dev team with behind-the-scenes since the release of the Libra milestone update!

[h1]Avatar Weapon Improvements[/h1]

A large focus post-Libra in the test environment has centered around tuning and balancing for Avatar weaponry. With the addition of a variety of optics entering the game in Libra, further playtesting has necessitated multiple iterations of fine-tuning damage rates, fire rates, damage drop-off, and recoil patterns.

As part of the multiple passes that have been made to the Avatar arsenal, weapon options have been somewhat streamlined to ensure clear distinction between weapons, as well as highlighting key trade-offs between weapon choices.

Weapon factors including damage & fire rates have been through considerable adjustments as the Test Pilots have significantly contributed to our goal of supporting a variety of playstyles while ensuring that each playstyle is not only viable, but feels satisfying for you during combat.

[h1]Battle craft Combat Exploration[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/f17344e068191ccb6194fac565f79318760546be.jpg[/img]

We have long recognized the need to make space combat in battle craft feel as gratifying as the FPS combat, and a major focus currently behind-the-scenes revolves around accomplishing just that.

In a sense, we've somewhat gone back to the drawing board to evaluate not only the relationship between space & FPS combat, but also to really lean into the foundational structure that our battle craft operate on and crank up the polish to make space combat as satisfying as possible.

While we are still exploring several options for design direction in this space [i](pun possibly intended)[/i], significant progress is being made thanks to countless hours of design and engineering efforts from members of our dev team, supported by rigorous testing from our Test Pilot Squadron.

We're excited to see the future of space combat in Project Genesis continue to evolve into an experience that rivals that of the FPS gunplay!

[h1]Controller Support Development[/h1]

So many of you have been asking for improved controller support for Project Genesis, and we are hard at work right now putting a ton of hours in with our amazing Test Pilots working to get that controller support in your hands [i](quite literally lol)[/i]!

We are currently testing Aim Assist functionality for controllers as well as adjusting the settings and options for customizing the controller feel to your particular liking. If you are a controller player on PC, we would love to have you join our [url=https://form.jotform.com/213086836745161]Test Pilot Squadron[/url] and help us refine the controller support to its max potential.

[h1]Game Mode Discovery[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/308e40ac9864d61f3a1342edeba194274a79b895.jpg[/img]

As we have been deep into exploration of space & FPS combat direction options, we have also been dedicating significant energy towards the relationship between both combat environments. This has led to some exciting ideas for future game modes and styles of gameplay that could enter Project Genesis in the future.

While we aren't ready to reveal the specifics of these ideas quite yet, we can say that the current proposals include not only game modes familiar to FPS players from other titles, but include some variations of common game modes as well as unique game modes specific to Project Genesis!

[b]Want to get in on the action and contribute your voice?[/b] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/8circuitstudios]Discord server[/url] and get access to these exciting new developments by joining our [url=https://form.jotform.com/213086836745161]Test Pilot Squadron[/url]! See you in the lobbies soon, Pilots.

notes.title: Developer Update - October 1
notes.content:
We're excited this Developer Update to showcase some awesome things happening within our community as we kick off Cohort 05 for the Wounded Warrior Project Test Pilot program, celebrate our amazing Affiliate Partners that were recently promoted, & update you on current and upcoming community events that you can join in on!

[h1]Wounded Warrior Project Cohort 05[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/539b8af33e7886f624af6fdd9c304e4f5f390016.jpg[/img]

For nearly a year, 8 Circuit Studios has been teamed up with Wounded Warrior Project in an ongoing collaboration providing behind-the-scenes of game development experience to WWP Alumni & Family Support Members. Cohort 05 has just kicked off and is the largest Cohort so far, with over 50 Alumni & Family Support Members gearing up to get their hands dirty in unreleased, private Project Genesis builds.

The Project Genesis Wounded Warrior Project Test Pilot program is designed to offer an introduction into the development process for Project Genesis and video game development in general. With 6 weeks of game testing, bug reporting, play balancing, Q&A workshops & much more, Cohort 05 is shaping up to be one of the most exciting Cohorts thus far.

[h2]Affiliate Partner Promotions[/h2]

[previewyoutube=nKzDEyH1BB4;full][/previewyoutube]

The true heroes of the Project Genesis community can be found within our Affiliate Partner Program, and we recently had the honor of recognizing standout Affiliate Partners with a promotion ceremony that leveled-up their status in the community and in-game.

From Ambassadors recruiting new players & making the Discord server a positive and fun place to hang out, Test Pilots that have spent countless hours testing and providing feedback, and Creators that have live streamed & created photo and video content to get the game in front of new eyes, in their own unique way each have contributed significantly and as a dev team we are truly grateful.

[/list]

[h2]Community Events[/h2]

[h3]DevSessions[/h3]
Some of our favorite memories with our community have been made during our weekly DevSessions, where we get in-game with community members and team up with/face-off against the community as a dev team!

With the recent addition of our new Community Manager, Shauna "Cherry" Chambers, we've doubled the number of weekly DevSessions now available to you. Whether you want to kick it with some of us on the dev team, or bully us by holding our spawn doors, we would love to have you join us for our regular sessions:

[list]
[*] NA Server DevSession: Wednesday @ 4pm Pacific Time
[*] EU Server DevSession: Friday @ 11am Pacific Time
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/8circuitstudios]Discord server[/url] and not only will you be able to RSVP any events you're planning on attending, but also be able to hop into our DevSession voice channel and talk shop with the rest of the community and members from our dev team.

[h3]Sweat16[/h3]
For those of you that enjoy those high-intensity, ultra competitive Project Genesis games...Sweat16 is coming back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/0fb51741b997698c17b0db5c78f80bcbe5244100.jpg[/img]

That's right. Beginning in November, the 1st Saturday of each month will feature a roughly 60-minute session of all out sweaty games. To be the best you've got to beat the best, so hone your skills, gear up, and let's see who gets bragging rights at the end of each Sweat16 session.

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/8circuitstudios]Discord server[/url] and never miss out on any of our upcoming events! See you in the lobbies soon, Pilots.

notes.title: Developer Update - September 15
notes.content:
[h1]Massive FPS Weapon Improvements![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/d7d8cbef52d7835d63603f66a0bd6810c8fba32c.png[/img]

With the pre-alpha Libra milestone & hotfix now in your hands, you have access to a ton of improvements for the Avatar FPS weapon arsenal. New optics, weapon models, recoil adjustments, damage drop-off & ADS sensitivity sliders are now at your disposal, and our Test Pilots have diligently tested and provided feedback to raise the bar for FPS gunplay in Project Genesis.

[h2]New FPS Optics[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/eacae4edc59a829fa714483ac8d46b607decc7ec.gif[/img]

Gone are the days of solely 1x scopes in Project Genesis, because in the pre-alpha Libra milestone, we've outfitted the whole cast of FPS weapons with an array of new optics & magnification options. Our Art Director, Mark Nicolino, who wore an incredible amount of hats during the Libra development cycle, worked tirelessly to make these new sights available for you in-game.

Depending on the weapons you choose to wield in combat, you will now put rounds down range using new iron sights, red dot sights, thermal scopes, and long-range DMR & sniper scopes! With future plans to allow a plethora of customization options for sights in Project Genesis, this first iteration of new optics lays the foundation for FPS weapon loadout capabilities catered to your specific playstyle.

[h2]New FPS Weapon Models[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/9ea4d421027f5860fd945b7093853b410af543cf.png[/img]

From concept to reality! Back in February we showed you concept sketches for new FPS weapons designed by Dipo Muh, our Concept Artist, and now in Libra we have rigged up 2 weapons exclusive to Project Genesis that you can take into battle.

The first of many more to come, the new weapon models available in Libra include the Bozar .50 LMG & the Trio SMG.

[b]Bozar .50 LMG[/b]
[list]
[*] 100 Round Drum
[*] 200 Round Max Ammo Capacity
[*] Medium Fire Rate
[*] High Damage Output
[/list]
[b]Trio SMG[/b]
[list]
[*] 25 Round Clip
[*] 100 Round Max Ammo Capacity
[*] High Fire Rate
[*] Medium-High Damage Output
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/9e97c70aeb2d7b7bf6523dd2461acb8c78c4c757.gif[/img]

[h2]FPS Recoil Changes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/2312adb6e53cce27d7d6a4aaa34d941874dd0eda.gif[/img]

Although we have gone through several iterations on FPS recoil behavior in past milestone release cycles, we really wanted to make notable improvements to recoil patterns in the Libra update. With the help of rigorous testing and feedback from our amazing Test Pilots with our QA Lead, Dwayne Beck at the helm, Christian Aguila Perez, our Gameplay Designer, dedicated significant focus in refining recoil across the entire arsenal of FPS weapons, aligning weapon function and performance more closely with industry standards.

[h2]FPS Damage Drop-Off[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/13547be672a6e79eae17bd528f4d7c28e8c737ba.png[/img]

In addition to bettering recoil patterns and behavior, Christian also implemented the first iteration of damage drop-off for FPS weapons. As an integral aspect of weapon balancing and differentiation between weapon types, this initial pass for damage drop-off lays the groundwork for future refinements and balancing across Avatar weaponry.

[h2]ADS Sensitivity Slider Controls[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/b295e899f0e1caf77eb5f24ebd4311550e039c09.gif[/img]

To complement the new updates and feature implementations for FPS weapons in Project Genesis, the first iteration of separate ADS sensitivity slider controls has been included in the Libra milestone update, allowing you to fine-tune your sens when scoped in on your enemies. With additional ADS sensitivity customization coming in future iterations, we plan to allow for additional slider controls based on magnification for your chosen optic.

[h2]Join the Test Pilot Squadron[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/9b11711ca1f5d01a4377a72b273417ed91f85a02.png[/img]

As we've mentioned above and many times before, none of this could be possible without the incredible efforts of our Test Pilots. Monday - Friday each week, these amazing community members team up in Discord for guided testing sessions, helping to identify and write bugs, provide input and feedback on weapon balancing, and rigorously put each feature set through the grinder to ensure it ends up in your hands in the best form possible.

In addition to receiving access to the latest and greatest content before anyone else, our Test Pilots receive exclusive perks in our Discord server and in-game as a token of our thanks for their contribution.

We want YOU to join the Test Pilot Squadron today and help shape the future of Project Genesis!

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/8circuitstudios]Discord server[/url] and apply to be a Test Pilot [url=https://form.jotform.com/213086836745161]HERE[/url].

notes.title: Your Libra Pre-Alpha Milestone is Here, Pilots!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G6NxFWUtEAo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]

Hi - I’m Noel from 8 Circuit Studios, and I’m looking forward to introducing you to the Project Genesis Pre-Alpha Libra milestone.

In this milestone, we have focused on introducing significant amounts of new content for you to enjoy, while also refining and improving existing features and systems in-game. With more tools, equipment, abilities, and systems at your disposal, your options for dominating your opponents in-game have never been better.

[h1]NEW FPS OPTICS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/27cf227bd9dd105f056675ca47fc1f3253687bcb.png[/img]
You’ve asked for optics to be added to the FPS arsenal and we agree that it’s about time we got some in your hands! Our first round of optics has been implemented in Libra, and you’ll now find an array of new iron sights, red dot sights, thermal scopes, and long-range sniper scopes on the majority of your favorite FPS weapons.

As with most of our content updates, optics are still very much a work in progress. However, the underlying systems are implemented to give you a chance to see how the optical options feel. While there’s still significant amounts of playbalance iteration, your feedback will help prioritize which features to focus on. 

With the addition of the newly-added optics, a variety of magnification options has been allocated across the various optic designs, broadening your ability to strategize your approach in-game and further tailor your favorite playstyle. Whether you want to get up close and personal with your enemies, prefer to take high-precision shots from elevated positions in the distance, or mix it up somewhere in between, you now have multiple options in FPS weaponry for whatever playstyle you bring to the battlefield.

[h1]NEW FPS WEAPON MODELS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/f70a4b01287a73cf41d92e11c9f1af99ccbd5b91.png[/img]
If you’re excited about the new FPS optics coming into the game, just wait until you see the first two of our brand-new weapon models in-game! Behind the scenes, we have been hard at work building out custom FPS weapon models exclusive to Project Genesis and the first two we’re getting into your hands are the Trio SMG and the Bozar .50 LMG.

We can’t wait to see you get in-game and destroy your opponents while wielding these toys of destruction outfitted with a new look & feel, and we are excited to continue to add even more new weapon models in the upcoming milestones so you can climb the leaderboards in style.

Also, in addition to the new FPS optics and models, we’ve added aim down sights (ADS) separate sensitivity options that are now available for you in Settings so you can fine tune your hip fire to ADS sensitivity values to make you even more lethal in combat.

[h1]NEW DYNAMIC FPS SPAWNING SYSTEM[/h1]

So many of you have provided feedback related to our previous spawning system and have identified valid concerns with the ability for players to spawn camp opponents in Avatar form. In Libra, we are introducing the first of many upcoming refinements to the spawn system overall with the implementation of dynamic spawns for FPS environments.

The new dynamic spawning system uses a weighting system to grade all SpawnPoints based on factors including, distance from enemies & friendlies, line of sight to enemies, previous deaths nearby, and many others.

After factoring in all relevant data, the new spawning system chooses the highest rated spawn point and inserts the respawning Avatar in a manner that allows for more competitive integrity. When you respawn, you will now be able to get your bearings, choose a course of action, and jump into the fray.

[h1]AVATAR TACTICAL SPRINT & BATTLECRAFT TACTICAL BOOST[/h1]

Speed is king in so many ways, and your ability to chase down your opponents or rush behind cover to avoid incoming damage is critical. With that in mind, we have added Tactical Sprint to Avatar movement and Tactical Boost to Battle craft.

When layered on top of the Avatar sprint and Battle craft boost functions, these additions provide a temporary burst of extra speed so you can close the distance on an enemy dodging your output damage or rush away to safety when your health pool is critical.

[h1]BATTLE CRAFT COUNTERMEASURES[/h1]

Countermeasures for battle craft dogfights are one of the most requested features that we’ve received over the past milestones, and in Libra, we have added the first two countermeasures to enter the game.

These two counter measures are proof-of-concept to help us see if the pacing of battle craft combat is improved with these as active abilities. With your input, especially so if you’ve been inducted into the Test Pilot program, we’ll be able to ascertain how effective or useful these type of countermeasures are or if we need to expand the design in a different direction.

With the Flairs Ability and the Reflect Projectiles Ability, you will now be able to choose the ability that suits your playstyle the best and have additional protection from incoming attacks. Combined with the newly-implemented Battle craft Tactical Boost, your survivability potential in space combat is at an all-time high.

[h1]EXPERIMENTAL WHITEBOX MAPS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/7d428fda8a0ace9043ee5d07376593ef8b099123.png[/img]
In their current state, these maps are considered “whitebox” maps - this simply means that although the map layout designs have gone through multiple iterations, they haven’t been outfitted with the textures and props you’re accustomed to seeing in the existing Project Genesis maps. This type of level “sketch” allows us to focus feedback on flow, sightlines, and other major moment-to-moment experiences within a map, and then leave the option to drastically reconfigure the level based on pertinent feedback.

However, we were too excited about seeing what you can do with these new combat spaces to leave them out so we’re giving you these experimental maps to do battle in! This is the perfect chance to try out the new FPS optics and weapon models in environments that are larger in scale than any of the current FPS spaces. Unlock access to these new environments by reaching level 10 in-game and use the newly-implemented filter option to explore the latest maps.

[h1]FPS ENVIRONMENT VISIBILITY UPDATES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/bafea923c1ed1f57e9682efa6bb7bb4b94f04cd0.png[/img]

Target identification and target acquisition are critical components of competitive FPS gameplay, and we have made significant adjustments to many areas within the FPS environments to increase your visibility in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/f60cd6342ece168b2304ab05d653a9f33873c983.png[/img]
With the implementation of Phase 1: Material Performance Pass as the first of several additional iterations, we have reduced the detail within the FPS combat spaces to increase visibility and optics performance. Favoring detail, color, and texturing in key spaces within the environment and reducing them in generalized areas ensures that you are more easily able to locate your opponents and focus the majority of your energy on your target acquisition and gun skills.

[h1]MAJOR AUDIO UPDATES[/h1]

We know sound is a critical component for information, tactical strategy, and combat, and in Libra, we’ve made sweeping changes to the audio in-game. Occlusion, attenuation, movement, weapons, throwables, objectives, and match state have been updated to provide you the most relevant and high-priority information needed for you to be victorious in-game.

You’ll now notice in-game that actions being performed close to you are much louder than those in the distance, but you’ll still be able to hear far sounds at a reduced volume so you can stay informed about the greater battlespace.

In addition to a wide array of new sound effects in-game, dynamic new musical cues and transitions have been added to both immerse you in the heat of the action while also keeping you up-to-date on the status of the match or game.

[h1]DOMINION GAME MODE UPDATES[/h1]

Dominion is a game mode that you have expressed a love for in Project Genesis, but you’ve also provided valuable feedback to us for how to improve the gameplay in this mode. We’ve listened to your input, and in Libra, we’ve made significant changes to several aspects of Dominion.

In addition to refining and improving the in-game messaging regarding point capture and updating information within your HUD, we’ve also adjusted several key components of this game mode. 

In response to your feedback regarding the average length of Dominion matches and expressing your desire for them to be longer, we’ve increased the total number of points needed to win from 1,000 to 2,000, doubling the average length of a match. We’ve also added team influence advantage when capturing points, allowing you to more rapidly capture any given point if more than one team member is present on the point during capture.

[h1]IN CONCLUSION[/h1]

In addition to the features and improvements mentioned previously, we’ve also implemented a new backend system, allowing for countless options to reward you further in-game, further balanced FPS weapons and Battle craft movement, improved messaging in your HUD, added Battle craft ADS target locking, and much more.

We are grateful for your continued support of Project Genesis and the valuable contributions that each of you have made to the development of the game, and we can’t wait to see what you think of the new additions in this milestone update. See you in the lobby, Pilots!

[h1]FIXES[/h1]

[list]
[*]Turned off Framerate Smoothing/FPS cap
[*]Disabled large Steam FX to reduce overdraw
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur when exiting the Game where MapMarkerComponents would be destroyed after the World had been torn down.
[*]Changed how some properties are Replicated on the VitalSystemsComponent to resolve an issue where AI do not get the Event for recharging their Health or Shield.
[*]Fixed an issue where Ship Lateral Movement would not cancel out when both Inputs for Left and Right were held at the same time
[*]Turned off shadow casting on background scene meshes
[*]Replaced AtmosphericFog with SkyAtmosphere component, all maps
[*]Fixed projectile collision on structures
[*]Mouse smoothing disabled by default
[*]Incendiary Grenade: Removed bounce, now detonates on collision at any axis
[*]Smoke Grenade: Fix to stop detonating in mid-air
[*]Fixed an issue where a replicated variable on the VitalSystemsComponent was being optimized out causing Shields to not regenerate when necessary
[*]Material optimizations for low quality setting, disabled superficial meshes for low quality setting
[*]Fixed a bug where changing of targets will stop the shield or healthbar from updating
[*]Major rework to the way Spread is handled in Blueprint to apply Multipliers based on Movement Type and Fire Rate over time to reduce inconsistencies in the final Spread value across Server and Client. Spread is now calculated in a predictable way, avoiding transient values that can be wildly inconsistent. This should hopefully help address the bug where Spread gets stuck in a tightened group after a period.
[*]Fixed an obscure issue where FPS Weapons would calculate out their NetSyncRandomSeed value to the point where it overflows to its maximum (undefined behavior) due to the nature of the sync mechanism. Modified the calculation to avoid this outcome.
[*]SecHoming health/shield update correctly when switching targets
[*]Fixed an issue where Health and Shields would fire their Replicated functions when their value hadn't changed, causing multiple subsequent events to fire inappropriately
[*]Fixed an issue where the Replicated function for Shields was not firing the `OnShieldsDepleted` event on Clients
[*]Patched hole in Onslaught FPS
[*]Removed empty match start notification showing behind initial spawn screen
[*]Setup functionality on the FPS Weapons for allowing a custom PutDownTime to be passed into a Weapon being switched out from context of the Weapon being switched in
[*]Modified the Melee Weapon to utilize the above functionality to change how quickly it gets pulled up for a more fast paced feel. Adjusted its BringUp and PutDown timings as well to better dial in a faster result.
[*]Moved the `MajorPlayerAchievements` notification layer to the KillFeed Widget so that they persist after the death of the controlled pawn
[*]Added in functionality to allow FPS Weapons to decide if they want to interrupt Sprint or not. Enabled by default. Set the Melee Weapon to not interrupt Sprint via the above functionality.
[*]Added GTL to firing range and training maps
[*]Fix for crash caused by missing ThirdPersonWeapon class on FPS Weapons
[*]Reworked the way that Placeables for Ships via FieldUpgrades manage their firing mechanism. Previously the Placeable would be Switched to as a Weapon and then naturally go through its firing sequence. Now they are manually setup and fired without being switched to. This is in effect designed to fix an issue where while firing another Ship Weapon, it would cause the Placeable to not be set down but also being put on Cooldown. This new method has the added benefit of decoupling Placeable usage from Primary/Secondary Weapon firing.
[*]Potential fix for crash caused when switching weapons and the weapon could not locate the PutDown function
[*]Turned off FPS weathering
[*]Modified the FPS Weapons to cause ADS Spread to kick in once ADS In has completed instead of as soon as ADS input is provided
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Update - August 1
notes.content:
[h1]Avatar Active Abilities![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/f6b5e5fefdb1b183f4d917dd7afe2fea2eadf1f3.png[/img]

The Project Genesis Libra pre-alpha milestone update is right around the corner, and will be bringing some new additions to the abilities system first introduced in Kepler. Many of you have become wizards of game theory through the use of the current Avatar active abilities, but for those of you that might not be familiar with what is available to you, this Developer Update is designed to get you up-to-speed!

[h2]Ammo Crate[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/44bdffa00006ab28a1ed7b98865c396f77123a0c.png[/img]

In the Kepler pre-alpha milestone update, ammo allocation was drastically changed, with the removal of unlimited ammo entering the game and making ammo conservation much more important. With the ammo crate, you can not only replenish 100% of your weapon ammo, but you'll even be able to replenish one of your throwables, giving you the ability to get back into the action quickly.

[h2]Shield Barrier[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/46b82f3517a25d8c1334b22a67782bad7f0245d1.png[/img]

The shield barrier has been in the game for quite some time now, and has undergone many different iterations. In its current form, deploying your shield barrier will trigger an animation in front of you that will provide a translucent barrier that will protect you from oncoming fire while also allowing you the ability to fire through your shield and deal damage to your opponents.

[h2]Heal Repair[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/97c5acdf7b3bd68c7dd6a05ea3b7c5ced9ea6cc3.png[/img]

Want the ability to heal up both your health and your allies? Then the heal repair might be just the active ability for you. When deployed, the heal repair activates a healing node on the ground and provides healing tethers to you and your teammates that are within the vicinity. 

[i]Pro Tip: When used in conjunction with the shield barrier, the heal repair can provide rapid stabilization to your team as you take cover behind the shield and top up your HP pool before heading back into combat.[/i]

[h2]Turrent Drone[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/160d378eb34b6f364f33fb812ef95ea6810637ea.png[/img]

Whether you crave information on the battlefield or simply want more firepower going down range, the turret drone is a great choice for both. With loud audio queues during firing, not only will the turret drone deal damage to your opponents, but it also provides key information about enemy locations, allowing you to flank and dominate your opponents with the info the turret drone provides.

[h2]Tactical Insert[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/7ce9700cff41d30ff9c2526f511d146c37e490c0.png[/img]

As one of the most game-changing active abilities introduced in the pre-alpha Kepler milestone, the tactical insert provides unique methods for infiltrating enemy lines and spawning your Avatar at a specific location you choose when deploying the tactical insert. Get back into the action as fast as possible and cover ground by spawning with the tactical insert!

[i]Pro Tip: Some of our most talented Pilots have utilized the tactical insert in the Detonation game mode - after an initial Breach & Board of the enemy capital ship, Pilots will deploy a tactical insert which allows them the ability to instantly spawn back onto the enemy capital ship, should they die behind enemy lines.[/i]

Hone your skills in-game before the Libra pre-alpha milestone drops and adds additional layers of complexity to the game!

notes.title: Developer Update - July 1
notes.content:
[h1]Behind-the-Scenes Sneak Peak![/h1]
We have heard your requests for additional content to be added in Project Genesis loud and clear, and we have been hard at work alongside our amazing Test Pilots experimenting with numerous FPS & battle craft environments, as well as exploring creative new game modes and gameplay styles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/522f0c560e5868d1bd86223be43c91bc9f8187c4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle craft Combat Environments[/h2]

One of our most important goals when designing for battle craft dogfights is to replicate that high-impact, visceral, and fast-paced experience that exists in the FPS combat space. As we continue to refine battle craft movement and weapon design, we have become increasingly aware of the dramatic effects that the environment in which those dogfights occur impact the feel of the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/f354aab5086ff119e636bb7b30af453785af3a43.png[/img]

Our Art Director, Mark Nicolino, has been working hard to create a variety of different space combat environments, each with a unique look and feel that significantly shifts the space theater gameplay across the various battle craft.

From sweeping cosmic landscapes to industrial atmospheres, we are delving into new territory for the exterior environments with the goal of providing you exciting spaces to dominate your enemies in the skies.

[h2]FPS Combat Arenas[/h2]

For all of our gunners out there, don't worry we haven't forgotten about you! With the help of the Test Pilots, over the past weeks Mark has crafted a variety of dynamic FPS combat arenas designed to provide variety to gameplay, theory crafting, & playstyles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/9ab3466c05407286dcab59a21386050940bc6948.png[/img]

Most of these FPS environments have been created at a larger scale than many of the interior spaces currently available in Project Genesis and feature tactical vantage points, dynamic sightlines, & an array of varying cover.

Whether you enjoy sniping your enemies from a high ground position, or you like to get up-close and personal while wielding a shotgun, we have been excited to see these new combat spaces enable players to maximize effectiveness regardless of personal playstyle.

[h2]Additional Game Mode Testing[/h2]

But wait, there's more! As a result of the exploration and development surrounding interior and exterior environments, a plethora of new & creative ideas for additional game modes have emerged, and we are excited to see what will ultimately emerge from this brainstorming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/10acf53d41ea52754d51205743d1012fd7db343d.png[/img]

Since all of the environments and game mode exploration are still in early testing and design phases, we can't give away all the secrets just yet, but we'll share a small example of some of the new ideas that have emerged as a result of the new environments Mark has created.

In the image above, the image on the left depicts a capital ship hosting an FPS environment on the upper deck, while the image on the right depicts the first-person POV on that FPS space. The ability to transition from battle craft to boots on the ground on top of a capital ship is just [i][b]one[/b][/i] of the many exciting ideas coming from both the Dev Team and our amazing Test Pilots!

[h2]Become a Test Pilot and Get the Latest & Greatest[/h2]

Speaking of Test Pilots...did you know that our Test Pilots have not only had access to see these environments in their entirety, but have also been regularly playtesting these new spaces for weeks now? They have, and you can too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/27eb016a2db643de2434d2d815505b6ad65d06ec.png[/img]

[b]We Want YOU[/b] to join our Test Pilot Program, where you can go behind-the-scenes of game development, learn about bug writing & reporting, and provide feedback and suggestions for improving the game.

Interested in becoming a Test Pilot and being the first to see the latest & greatest new content? [b][url=https://discord.gg/8circuitstudios]Join our Discord server[/url][/b] and apply [url=https://form.jotform.com/213086836745161][b]HERE[/b][/url].

notes.title: Developer Update - June 15
notes.content:
[h1]Conquer the Skies in Battle Craft![/h1]
In Project Genesis, being able to defeat your opponents in FPS combat environments is only half the battle, and experienced Pilots understand that understanding the fleet of battle craft and the variety of weapons they can wield is critical to mission success in the space theater. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/7eca7555dba6220f32f8f1e2b74c5d102820b144.jpg[/img]

[h2]Choose Your Perfect Battle Craft[/h2]

Whether you prefer nimble and agile smaller ships or resilient and durable larger battle craft, the 8 battle craft in Project Genesis afford you a variety of options to empower your specific playstyle.

Within the hangar bay, you'll have the option of outfitting up to 4 battle craft loadouts, allowing you to equip the battle craft you prefer to pilot with the weapon arsenal of your choosing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/77014fc561abf4470fbd066eb2c30d5ff76f127d.png[/img]

Choosing one of the lighter battle craft will provide a speed advantage over your opponents, but you'll need to keep an eye on your ship's shield and armor values, as the lighter ships are much more susceptible to being destroyed with burst damage.

Want to go with a heavier ship? We have a selection for you to choose from, but keep in mind that with the more durable ships comes a significant reduction in speed and movement. You'll be able to tank much more incoming damage in your dogfights but you will need to rely on your gun skills to outplay your opponent as your ability to dodge incoming damage will be much more difficult.

[h2]Select Your Ideal Weapon Loadout[/h2]

Each battle craft can be equipped with a primary and secondary weapon loadout, with a wide variety of weapons at your disposal to form the most lethal combination to destroy your opponents. In the battle craft menu, and each time you spawn while in-game, you'll be able to select the perfect loadout for the game mode, map, and combat environment you are facing.

Primary weapons are available in several categories, including hitscan, projectile, & beam weapons.

Hitscan weapons are a Point of Aim = Point of Impact weapon; this means that when you fire your weapon, the bullets will instantly impact your opponent in the same way firing a pistol in an FPS environment functions.

Projectile weapons in Project Genesis deal significant amounts of damage, but require you to anticipate your opponent's movement and lead your shots slightly to account for the time it will take your projectile ammunition to travel to your opponent's location.

Beam-style weapons such as the battle craft laser are all about your skill in tracking your opponent. Acquiring and accurately tracking your target will reward you with increased damage over time, and in the right hands can melt an enemy battle craft rapidly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/d8bf896dc53ea2c464be5034a64dccaffd4694b8.jpg[/img]

Secondary weapons in Project Genesis feature homing-style functionality, providing burst damage to your opponents to complement your shots on target from your primary weapon.

The newly-implemented battle craft targeting system is designed to aid you in dealing damage to your opponents and you will now receive clear visual and audio queues that will notify you that your weapon is on-target and ready to be fired. Although your opponents do have the ability to dodge secondary weapon fire with skillful maneuvering, long sightlines and open environmental areas will aid your success in wielding these powerful weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/73f3ac7fc918f895c606f3e096c7432660593855.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dominate Space in Style[/h2]

So you've chosen your ideal battle craft and weapon loadouts, and you've started to master dogfights in space. But what if you could send your opponents back to spawn in style?

You can! For a limited-time only while Project Genesis is still in Early Access, you can cement yourself as one of the earliest supporters by becoming a Platinum Founder. With an animated emblem, banner, 8 slick skins & much more, as a Platinum Founder you can not only traverse the cosmos in style, but your opponents will know exactly who they're messing with every time you win one of your dogfights.

[previewyoutube=IZ92ApIO70k;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out what is included in the Platinum Founders Pack and start conquering your opponents in high-fashion: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1651913/Project_Genesis__Platinum_Founders_Pack/

notes.title: Developer Update - June 1
notes.content:
[h1]Admiration Comes from PRESTIGE![/h1]
In our last Developer Update, we highlighted the expanded biome environments that have been included in the Kepler pre-alpha milestone update, and for this Developer Update we're turning the spotlight on the exclusive [b][i]EPHEMERA[/i][/b] that unlocks as you progress through the Prestige levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/fae40f195a28c2bfeaf41d90747f75a62cddb842.png[/img]

[h2]Earn Prestige Every 100 Levels[/h2]

Completing matches in the player versus player game modes: Detonation, Dominion, & Onslaught will award you XP in-game, leveling up your account. Kills, kill streaks, objective completion & more serve as multipliers for the XP you receive for match completion, awarding you additional experience points throughout the PVP game modes.

For each 100 levels you achieve for your account in-game, you will be awarded a Prestige level that will be indicated in the upper right of the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/12252fd7bd4f405e0734c0719fee80177a859a95.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gain New Ephemera with Prestige[/h2]

As you progress through the Prestige levels, the first 6 levels will also award you exclusive Prestige visuals, displaying your dedication to the grind across a variety of places within the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/51f6c8d874eebef7838f5b20326a0edaf76b54ad.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developer Update - May 16
notes.content:
[h1]Level Up and Gain Access to Expanded Biome Environments![/h1]
The Kepler pre-alpha milestone update has expanded on the previous hidden biome environments included in the Jupiter milestone, and now you are rewarded even more for leveling up your account in the PVP game modes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/1cbd5269a61c1bb8e67f2dc92907c952aa4a2201.jpg[/img]

[h2]Unlock the Star Map[/h2]

The Star Map is the key to travel throughout the expanded biome environments, and to gain access to the Star Map, you'll need to put in the work to level your account up to Prestige 1 which you'll receive after reaching level 100. Competing in any of the PVP game modes will award you XP for achievements such as kills/kill streaks and objective completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/73bb7ae5acd7513b60756e35f3383bd0dc8dc0cf.jpg[/img]

[h2]Explore Biome Environments[/h2]

As you unlock biome environments via the Star Map, you will be granted access to travel to the various biomes, ushering you into a single-player PVE experience. Each biome environment features a different look and feel, giving you a unique experience throughout each biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/54f416e91f202678d69d625aa80b2d84949b194a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/e665ce7000a8ad68f861cb505c1910182310862e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/55d3a8c74154a5495e82cd09b14390d4cd65669c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Obtain AI Memory Drives[/h2]

Throughout the biome environments, you'll need to carefully search throughout the terrain for hidden AI Memory Drives. Once located, you'll need to capture the AI Memory Drive to complete the objective for each biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/4f2ecd15ea9e35c24afc197f017a51d00cbb39c9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fight Enemy AI[/h2]

Thought you were alone while exploring the biomes? Think again! During your journeys, you'll have to keep a close eye out for enemy AI that will seek to eliminate you and send you back to the spawn point in the biome. Don't worry though - you'll have the full array of weapons, throwables, and abilities to choose from to aid you in your mission.

[i]Pro Tip: The newly-added Tactical Insert is a great choice when exploring the biomes. Consider using it to avoid having to start from the initial spawn should you happen to die to an enemy AI.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/4fe9026e464dadf7d5ea25a9f93201cb38e27be8.jpg[/img]

The biome environments await your discovery! Start your journey today:

notes.title: The Era of the Pre-Alpha Kepler Milestone has Arrived
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WT-QIH7-irk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]

Hi - I’m Noel from 8 Circuit Studios, and I’m looking forward to introducing you to the Project Genesis Pre-Alpha Kepler milestone.

In this milestone, we are introducing significant improvements and modifications based on your feedback and input, ramping up your experience in-game and injecting substantial changes to the visual and functional aspects of gameplay.

[h1]NEW THROWABLES + LETHAL & TACTICAL SLOTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/221c9df7124e1bbd7ebc1a9843d61965f5f8f9cd.png[/img]
In the Jupiter pre-alpha milestone update, five new throwables were introduced, shifting the tactical meta in-game. With more ways to outsmart and outplay your opponents, we have been impressed with the incredibly creative ways you have developed to dominate your adversaries, but in the Kepler pre-alpha milestone update, we’re adding even more tools to your throwable arsenal.

In Kepler, you’ll have access to two new throwables: a gas grenade which emits a toxic vapor that deals damage to opponents caught in the fumes, and a decoy grenade that sets off visual and audio queues designed to distract and disorientate your opponents.

In addition to the two new throwables, we have now added an additional throwable slot to your Avatar loadouts, allowing you to bring one lethal and one tactical throwable into combat. Let the theory crafting begin!

[h1]NEW SHIP TARGETING[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/b3a8fa7b0642231e1c7a550674a217d621732ccd.png[/img]
In response to incredible feedback from our community and Test Pilots, Kepler introduces refinement to the battle craft weapon targeting system. This new targeting system will make acquiring your enemy’s battle craft more accurate, allowing you to crank up the damage with more precision and lethal aim.

Additionally, the new targeting system also introduces significantly greater feedback when aiming, providing you critical information for target lock line of sight, acquire time, lock angle, and max distance. You’ll also receive audio queues to notify you when you’ve acquired a target, empowering you with intelligence to emerge from your dogfight victorious.

[h1]SHIP MOVEMENT[/h1]
In Jupiter, we introduced a secondary movement option (auto-orientation) for your battle craft controls, and in Kepler, we’ve refined overall ship movement to allow you to flank enemies and dodge incoming damage more effectively. You’ll now be able to navigate vertically with significantly increased speed, aligning the battle craft horizontal movement speed with the vertical movement.

If you’ve been in-game since the Jupiter milestone, you likely have experienced a disorienting effect when impacting asteroids or other environmental objects. In Kepler, you’ll notice a significant reduction in camera collision if you do manage to sideswipe one of the terrain features, as well as a faster reorientation to get you back into the action.

[h1]UI DPI SCALING SUPPORTING 4K[/h1]
Use a 4K or ultrawide monitor? You’re in luck because in Kepler, we’ve added support for both, allowing the in-game UI to scale appropriately, regardless of the monitor you have at your battle station. 

[h1]INTERIOR MAP UPDATES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/fc602daf769f3036e5f81390fa26d2c68063a814.png[/img]
Test Pilot feedback has improved map and level design across several of the interior environments, with the goal of increasing the significance of actions you take in-game during matches.

Additional routes to the bombsite have been implemented in the Onslaught game mode, giving you extra resources to strategize and wargame your way to victory, while refinements within other interior environments have been added to improve interactions and counterplay in-game.

[h1]LIMITED AMMO[/h1]
In preparation for a wide variety of new abilities coming to Project Genesis in the near future, a major change in ammo allocations is being introduced in Kepler. Avatar weapon ammo now features a limited ammo count, making shots on target more critical than ever.

Each time you spawn as an Avatar, you will now notice that in addition to the ammo count in your magazine, you also have a reserve ammo allocation. When you run out of your total ammo, or when you’re running low, you’ll have to find an ammo drop from another player that has died in the lobby.  

[h1]AVATAR HOMOGENIZATION[/h1]
Throughout our milestones you have seen us test playable cosmetic progression unlocks and unique classes for Avatars. In Kepler, we are turning design upside down as we begin to prepare and implement a robust abilities system that introduces buffet-style ability outfitting. 

You’ll now notice in-game that all Avatars are equal in scale, movement velocity, and weapons, as we level the playing field and set the stage for Passive, Active, and Ultimate abilities. This abilities system is designed to not only amp up your overall gameplay experience, but also to give you the power to customize your experience in-game in a way that is tailored to your playstyle as you dominate the competition!

[h1]AVATAR ABILITIES SYSTEM[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/5cc22d7deaa7708ee47726c973efa3945f6481e9.png[/img]
With Avatar classes being transitioned to the homogenized style just mentioned, the first iteration of the Avatar abilities system has been implemented in Kepler, introducing several dynamic abilities to take your gameplay strategy to the next level. 

With ammo being now limited in Kepler, you now can outfit your Avatar with an ammo crate that you can deploy on the battlefield to aid both you and your allies. Deployable cover, Heal Repair, and Turret Drones, previously limited to specific Avatar classes in Jupiter, now are available for all Avatars and provide valuable assets for you and your team as you assault the enemy objectives. 

One of the most game-changing abilities being introduced in Kepler is the Tactical Insert. This Avatar ability revolutionizes gameplay as you’ve known it, now allowing you to deploy a beacon within the interior environments that you can utilize to respawn to that exact location, inserting you behind enemy lines.

We can’t wait to see how you transform these and many other abilities into tactical and strategic plans to give you an edge over your competition!

[h1]IN CONCLUSION[/h1]

We are grateful for your continued support of Project Genesis and the valuable contributions that each of you have made to the development of the game. Let us know what you think of the additions in this milestone update!

Interested in getting more involved? Check out our brand new Affiliate Partner Program and see how you can get in on the action!
[previewyoutube=97gSE9leIUs;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/700240/Project_Genesis/

notes.title: Developer Update - April 15
notes.content:
[h1]The Project Genesis Pre-Alpha Milestone Update Kepler Soft Launches Next Week![/h1]
As a important member of our community, you'll get a chance to get your hands on the Kepler milestone before the broader public. This milestone is particularly special because of the significant improvements we've made to really amp up the moment to moment gameplay experience - with critical feedback coming in from our Test Pilots!

Check out a few of the major features we've added outlined below!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/db430b4ccb4cfa834335f99935db8172e19032d5.png[/img]

[h2]Sneak Peak - Part 3: Future Features[/h2]

[h3]Avatar Homogenization & Active Abilities System[/h3]
Throughout our milestones you have seen us test playable cosmetic progression unlocks and unique classes for Avatars. In Kepler, we are turning design upside down as we begin to implement a robust abilities system that introduces buffet-style ability outfitting.

You’ll now notice in-game that all Avatars are equal in scale, movement velocity, and weapons, as we level the playing field and set the stage for abilities entering the game. In the Kepler pre-alpha milestone update, our first round of active abilities will be introduced to Project Genesis, and combined with the homogenization of Avatars, will allow every ability to be accessed according to your preference regardless of the Avatar you choose in-game.

Our previous deployables: Turret Drone, Shield Barrier, and Heal Repair have been moved to an active abilities function and can now be added to your loadout, operating as a cooldown ability.

Two brand-new abilities are being added to the active abilities system in Kepler, and they are poised to revolutionize tactical gameplay in Project Genesis!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/44bdffa00006ab28a1ed7b98865c396f77123a0c.png[/img]

Avatar weapon ammo now features a limited ammo count, making shots on target more critical than ever. But don't worry! With the Ammo Crate being added as an active ability you can add to your loadout, you'll be able to replenish ammo for both you and your allies should you run low mid-fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/7ce9700cff41d30ff9c2526f511d146c37e490c0.png[/img]

Thought you had the gameplay figured out? Think again. With the Tactical Insert active ability at your disposal, you'll be able to deploy a beacon within the interior environments that you can utilize to respawn to that exact location after you die, inserting you right back into the fight!

[h3]Secret Lore & New Biome Environments[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/ccb6187cf7d38bafcb1f1d33e2d105ee8242820d.png[/img]

For those of you in our community or Test Pilot Program, you've had a chance in the Jupiter pre-alpha milestone update to explore a brand-new progression system that provides access to hidden biome environments, rewarding you for your grind in-game. In the Kepler pre-alpha milestone update, we are upping the ante and expanding our existing biomes to provide not only more content for you to enjoy, but adding additional environments for you to journey through as you put the hours in to unlock! 

Expand your horizons - your next great discovery awaits!

[h3]Join the Project Genesis Affiliate Partner Program![/h3]

Do you have a passion for content creation, competitive gaming, community leadership, or breaking games? Are you interested in getting more involved in the Project Genesis community? 

If so, we’d love to have you join our Affiliate Partner Program where you can participate in engaging opportunities to hone your creative skills, voice expertise and feedback, and develop your leadership skills within the community!

See the latest and greatest before everyone else, be recognized with badges & more both in-game and in our community Discord, and earn exclusive perks in the process!

Learn more [url=https://bit.ly/3BT1uDW]HERE[/url].

With big changes coming to Project Genesis in the Kepler milestone, now is perfect time gear up before the update goes live - grab your copy of Project Genesis today!

Abilities for in-game Avatars and battle craft has been a request from so many of you, and Project Genesis Test Pilots have been hard at work testing active, passive, and ultimate/kill streak abilities behind the scenes.

This abilities system is designed to not only amp up your overall gameplay experience, but also to give you the power to customize your experience in-game in a way that is tailored to your playstyle as you dominate the competition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/0d8e367ab757734920c035b9ac2d799bdbaf8276.jpg[/img]

[h3]Environment Adapations[/h3]
Test Pilot feedback has improved map and level design across several of the interior environments, with the goal of increasing the significance of actions you take in-game during matches.

Check out this one example from the interior environment in the Onslaught game mode, where additional routes to the bombsite have been implemented, giving you additional resources to strategize and wargame your way to victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/6d0ff74dbf60a893b5c9b6a999c6329f8e04de21.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/378360461aa8b1523a5d8c5691347a09ed4f9a17.jpg[/img]

[h3]Additional Throwables[/h3]

In Jupiter, five new throwables were introduced, shifting the tactical meta in-game. With more ways to outsmart and outplay your opponents, we have seen you develop some incredibly creative ways to demolish the enemy, and in the next pre-alpha milestone update, we're adding even more tools to the throwable arsenal.

While we're not giving all the secrets away just yet, you can check out one of the new throwables coming soon to Project Genesis. Any guesses on what this one is? [i](Comment below if you think you know!)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/bfb9326d388c9bafc0b4aaf5a1d0bd315716d53c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Discord Level Progression & Economy[/h3]

Here's a feature that isn't even a [i]coming soon[/i] one! Within our Discord server, you can now earn 5 additional roles within the server for your activity in the community & you also can earn virtual currency in the form of MoonMoney.

Engagement and participation within the server and during community in-game events will award you both XP & MoonMoney.

As you climb through the levels with XP in Discord, you now can achieve 5 new roles ranging from Cadet to Battle craft Commander. 

MoonMoney can be used to purchase Project Genesis-themed items within Discord that are added to your inventory within the server. 

Check out the current store items and good luck collecting them all, Pilot!

Join our Discord community [url=https://discord.gg/8circuitstudios]HERE[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/5214842b20b2c4204ad0d30d01542db842b61d26.png[/img]

Don't wait until the new pre-alpha milestone update arrives to sharpen up your in-game skills - grab your copy of Project Genesis today and be ready when the newest features go live!

notes.title: Jupiter is Here! See what's new INSIDE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/00e5697cbd9ad6d3e4002ec2f37d912fdad6a327.jpg[/img]
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]
Hi - I’m James, the Navigator at 8 Circuit Studios, and I’m looking forward to introducing you to the Project Genesis Pre-Alpha Jupiter milestone.

For this milestone, we have focused on introducing new environments & FPS Level Updates, our second iteration of Ship & Avatar Movement, introduced secret Lore progression, improved support for controllers, updated to Unreal Engine 4.27, and advanced the behavior of our AI Bots!

[h1]NEW ENVIRONMENTS & FPS LEVEL UPDATES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/d380e98b642ac7f26680ffa9f340eb83aa1c207f.png[/img]

After battle testing the environments, you can now play the completely restructured Ring level. With gameplay feedback from the Test Pilots, we've improved many of the level interiors for Onslaught and updated the Outpost map. We've improved time to engagement so you should be able to press the attack on your opponents much more quickly. Jump into the fray and let us know what you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/06eea3e2139d1c5107043d14ffceb633accb73af.png[/img]

[h1]SHIP & AVATAR MOVEMENT 2.0[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/77227dd1eddbe7d435ac2e0e20f90e171b2b6f87.png[/img]
So many of you have asked for improved Ship & Avatar movement and we are excited to hear what you think of the changes in Jupiter! Ship movement now accommodates 2 variations of flight styles and controls, and Avatar movement speed has been significantly increased across ALL Avatars!

[h1]SECRET LORE PROGRESSION[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/1f3b0cc44c4d7b544dc19c8630308949c7f99e5d.png[/img]
You have asked about the Lore behind Project Genesis, and now for the first time in Jupiter the Project Genesis Lore has been interwoven into our progression system. It's still a very early system, so don't expect Shakespeare yet, but you can level up in player-vs-player matches to gain access to hidden biome environments. We're exploring these new locations for future player vs environment gameplay and our single player intro levels!

[h1]CONTROLLER SUPPORT IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/3cc54225f796ddfd5dac151ad582f671a8d81b16.png[/img]
The requests for improved controller support have been heard, and we have been hard at work ramping up our development for controllers! Lots of progress has been made for Xbox controllers, and we are currently focusing on bringing PlayStation controller support online soon.

[h1]UNREAL ENGINE UPDATE 4.27[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/c080e796dcd0df62639e4f08e618c0a9d9e06a15.png[/img]
Project Genesis is now running on Unreal Engine 4.27, and with it comes additional stability for your gameplay, as well as unlocking powerful developer options that will allow us to improve your experience in-game dramatically.

[h1]ADVANCED AI BOT BEHAVIOR[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/e5189f860959d6eef01439b8f711008697a85ded.png[/img]
AI Bots have been improved in-game and now interact with the environment in a more intuitive manner. AI Bots will now successfully complete objectives, providing they are not killed by the opposing team.

[h1]IN CONCLUSION[/h1]
Thank you again for your continued support and involvement in the development of Project Genesis - we can't wait to see you in the lobbies.

Let us know your favorite part of the Jupiter pre-alpha Milestone!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/700240/Project_Genesis/

notes.title: Developer Update - January 15
notes.content:
[h1]The Project Genesis Jupiter Pre-Alpha Milestone is Right Around the Corner![/h1]

We’re already halfway through January, so that means it’s time to start looking ahead to the hard launch of the pre-alpha milestone release we’re calling Jupiter. Like its namesake, this milestone is a giant new build with tons of exciting new features. Today we’re going to give you a sneak peek on three features we think you’re going to love.

[h2]Dynamic Audio Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/641c7df7fcac22f05eb44a7a9723fd3f1cab9acd.jpg[/img]
Improving how everything sounds in turn makes everything feel better. We’ve been fortunate to bring Davor Manojlovic onto our team who has been completely revamping our audio system. This new system exposes you to thrilling and exotic new sounds. For the audiophiles, Davor has remastered key sound effects and has expanded “spacial dimensionality” to immerse you even more deeply into the Project Genesis universe.

[h2]8 Powerful Throwables for Avatars[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/1b6c78f8c9c82b582d3225ef0105dfedfa967b5b.jpg[/img]
Tactics, strats, and meta - we want to shake things up by giving you more offensive horsepower with throwable ordinance. We’ve also added new defensive throwables to help cover you from ambushes or to boost your changes when completing objectives. Check out these new weapons in Jupiter and let’s get your feedback on how differently the matches feel.

[h2]Secret Lore Additions to the Progression System [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/a1061390a56ca26bb2b4327a48893d5480d36869.jpg[/img]
If you’re a part of our community, or Test Pilot program, you’ve already gotten a chance to experience new features as a part of our Jupiter milestone soft launch. However, we’ve been saving a whole new progression system for the Jupiter hard launch! Many of you have been asking (demanding?) we begin opening up more about the Project Genesis lore. While still in the earliest-of-early stages with our player versus environment systems, we wanted to get your eyes on the new system to try out a new element in Project Genesis: grind PvP to unlock PvE.

Grab your copy of Project Genesis TODAY & be ready to hit the ground running when the Jupiter pre-alpha milestone goes live!

notes.title: Dynamic Iris Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/350f9604913ebc4507de37135223b6b2fb4db463.png[/img]
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]
Hi - I’m James, the Navigator at 8 Circuit Studios, and I’m looking forward to introducing you to the Project Genesis Pre-Alpha Iris milestone.

For this milestone, we have focused on Bot AI, Advanced Progression, Weapon Pick Ups, an Improved Training Ground, Capital Ship configurations, and weapon and ammo pickups.

[h1]AI SYSTEM & BOT BEHAVIORS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/4604e69006a41e37f72ace84fa863efced138988.jpg[/img]
After field testing our AI in player-versus-environment modes, we felt our bots were ready to get into some player-versus-player matches. You no longer need to worry about finding friends to play with or against. Now, PvP matches

Our bots are designed to provide a medium level of difficulty, and in PvP matches, racking up bot kills will count against your XP progression.


[h1]ADVANCVED PROGRESSION[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/7310ba573e94d5c63c4c7b5d1a525ac8b4d52124.jpg[/img]
We have added a new Prestige layer to the progression system for those of you who are game to grind.

Once you transcend level 100, you get a Prestige indicator in the upper right hand corner of the main menu. For every 100 levels achieved, you will level up your Prestige status. You will also be granted several of the skins that have previously been reserved for us developers.


[h1]WEAPON DROP & PICKUP SYSTEM[/h1]
In Hercules, we started experimenting with ammo picks up, and for Iris we have continued developing this feature to now include weapon pickups. If a friendly or opponent perishes, they’ll drop their weapon and you’ll be able to pick it up with your “USE” key.

Another benefit of the weapon pick up system is dynamic weapon swapping. We’ve applied this capability in the Solo Firing Range so that you can try out all of the available weapons without having to leave and then return to the range.


[h1]LEVEL ENHANCEMENTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/ea396dab4e04987a0179bce7bfa4bedfa79ab117.jpg[/img]
Level design improvements focused on unfair choke points, improving level flow, and adding color coding to help players better navigate ship interiors. We have also added environmental story elements that will be elaborated on in the future as we incrementally reveal Project Genesis’s lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/8961ddba532b1b5e6fc1435513570355ae97d0aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]IN CONCLUSION[/h1]
And finally, the Iris milestone has hundreds of other features and quality of life improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Check out the progress we’ve made with weapons and battle craft movement and give us your feedback. We’d love to hear if we’re moving in the right direction.

And as a reminder, we’ll be resetting the leaderboards and everyone’s level back to 0 to help us test the gameplay balance.

We look forward to seeing you in game Pilot! Good luck, and have fun.


[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE FEATURES[/h1]
- Major overhaul of the Sliding and Sprinting mechanics for the Character Movement Component - this was to eliminate consistency issues as well as other more severe issues related to network packets getting confused with the movement mode the Avatar was in depending on the current floor. Sliding and Sprinting functionality now more closely operates to that of the default Walking and Crouching movement modes.
- Avatar Death Effects
- Battle craft ship movement pass - Should generally feel a bit more responsive than before, especially the lighter/more nimble ships
- Updated Capital Ship models in Detonation (+color differentiated)
- Ship transparency added during aiming through
- Ship interior surface weathering explorations added
- Updated Persona design in main menu's with improved item display
- Updated Squad/Party system architecture that brings in fixes to crashes and invite rejecting
- Moved turret consoles so not in walls (Proteus)
- HUD objective indicator countdown smoothing visuals)
- Updating ship wreck version of AD_Rift, added opacity param to battle craft founder skin master material
- Tooltip visual updates
- Updated loading screen visuals
- Voice/Text Chat available in Menu's when in a party
- Set up strength curves which determine how much the weapon's weight affects each character's max speed based on their build
- Implemented new weapon weight vs character strength vs movement speed system
- Battle craft Engine Thrusters: Scaling thrusters based on player input rather than ship speed
- Chat Box (in-game) now accessible with ENTER

notes.title: Gigantic Hercules 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1]
Hi - I’m James, the Navigator at 8 Circuit Studios, and today I get to show you the updates that come with the Project Genesis Pre-Alpha Hercules 2.0 hotfix.

For this milestone, we wanted to focus on three major features that emphasize player progression, team play, and weapon archetypes that encourage new FPS tactics.

[h1]PROGRESSION[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/06a1b1fde0cc3a7ba29d3345ef32900ac8b4dff1.jpg[/img]
Firstly, we have improved the player progression experience by allocating emblems, skins, kill card banners, and unit palettes to you as you level up. There are over 200 items for you to collect on your path to achieving level 100.

For your convenience, this new system comes with green pip indicators that notify you where your newly allocated items are located in the main menu UI.

[h1]PARTIES/SQUADS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/09cf422ca8809cc56dd56c146a9de561f9e80323.jpg[/img]
In the very near future, we will be coordinating community tournaments and collaborating with great organizations like the Wounded Warrior Project and Stack Up Dot Org. 

To make team play easier in these cases, and to respond to community feedback, we have implemented the first version of our Squad system. This system allows you to create sessions and invite your Steam friends to multiplayer games.

[h1]FPS WEAPONS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/6b6df72e9c1aba1a61832c593b3023918bb24bc8.jpg[/img]
One of the most exciting features we’re looking forward to bringing you is a completely revamped FPS conventional weapon system. The FPS weapons should feel quite different from each other, and they follow small tactical arms categories like submachine gun, assault rifle, light machine gun, marksman rifle, and shotgun.

[h1]TWITCH DROPS[/h1]
With the Hercules 2.0 Hotfix, the highly sought-after Twitch drops have finally become available. If you are an approved Content Creator, your community will receive the exclusive Twitch kill card emblem and kill card banner...they need only watch your stream for two hours. If they watch your stream for four hours, they will earn the Twitch Wraith skin.

If you’d like to grow your community with us by participating in our creator program, join our Discord and let our team members know.

[h1]DLC PACKS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/1f630c83e289e5812b532742be6a8cc6bbcb19ca.jpg[/img]
If you have purchased Project Genesis, your support means everything to us. To say thank you, we have upgraded you to receive the Gold Founders Pack with the Hercules 2.0 update.

If you’d like to show off your generous support of the dev team we are offering 5 Founders Packs that will only be available while we’re in Steam Early Access. Once Project Genesis releases as a full version, you’ll never be able to get these Founders pack items again.

[h1]IN CONCLUSION[/h1]
And finally, the Hercules 2.0 milestone has hundreds of other features and quality of life improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. We look forward to seeing you in game Pilot! Good luck, and have fun.

[h1]QUALITY OF LIFE FEATURES[/h1]
- Near miss indicators for FPS conventional weapons
- New EMP behaviors
- New HUD indicators for objective progress
- Ship camera shake adjusted to be less brutal when taking damage
- Ship Weapons: Primaries: Set up firing to take turns on each individual turret to reduce overpower on ships equipped with multiple primary turrets.  Note: VFX ie. muzzle flash will play on all but will only be a visual discrepancy for the time being
- Ship Weapons: damage adjustments
- PVE: Added footstep audio to AI bots
- New HUD icons
- Onslaught: Reduced ship objective capture volume
- Updated loading screens with improved mask (visual)
- Added Unit & Weapon stats to in-game loadout screens
- Fixed turrets not doing any damage in battle craft theater
- Fix to disable FPS HUD once match is ended to prevent player inputs while breaching during the end of match
- Fix attempt for the crash during PvE Maps roll for players with big ping (200+)
- Fixed messaging to show proper attackers/defenders teams in RespawnMenu
- Fixed Total Score on leaderboards

notes.title: The Hercules Major Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/f0bd3b9047e7af17b8b3c5567721c6b7a11ad579.jpg[/img]
Hi - I’m James, the Navigator at 8 Circuit Studios, and I’m looking forward to introducing you to the Project Genesis Pre-Alpha Hercules milestone.

For this milestone, we have focused on customization, a new arsenal of battle craft weapons, and an experimental team-based Player vs Environment mode.

[h2][b]PLAYER CUSTOMIZATION[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/d114b2680423e00ef805e28fcbbe5d6fcffa4786.jpg[/img]
In the Hercules milestone, you now have the opportunity to explore the new customization system we’ve implemented to create and apply signature looks.

This new system allows you to customize your battle craft with a selection of palettes, and a significant number of skin wraps.

Customizing your avatars can be done as you would in the battle craft menu. Rotate your avatar to inspect your selections in a 360 degree view.

Whether you want to show off your look to your teammates, or leave a mark in your adversaries memory, the customization system will be your key to expressing your unique identity.

[h2][b]EMBLEMS & KILL CARDS[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/df9efd88b92c532399ec3576bffa8450b66cb46a.jpg[/img]
In addition to tailoring your battle craft and avatars, you can now create customized kill cards from a huge selection of emblems and backgrounds. These cards will appear on your opponents and teammates heads up display when you complete important accomplishments in-game.

[h2][b]BATTLE CRAFT WEAPONS[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/0c8a193150fa5e5a236c5bd6acd7d23fb6e9a87b.jpg[/img]
We’ve also provided another round of updates to our battle craft arsenal with over 20 modified weapons now included, and a new set of behaviors for homing missiles.

With only a few exceptions, we’ve allowed many of the battle craft to access the vast array of improved weapons for you to experiment with and provide the Project Genesis team feedback on. Be sure to fill out the player feedback form available.

[h2][b]EXPERIMENTAL PLAYER VS ENVIRONMENT MODE[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/79d79a72e19998b5cc059c805a63af89a1838936.jpg[/img]
You will also have access to an experimental Player versus Environment mode. This mode can be played alone, or with teammates to get familiar with the Project Genesis game mechanics. This new feature will open up the possibility of additional player vs environment game modes in the future.

And finally, the Hercules milestone has hundreds of other features and quality of life improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. We look forward to seeing you in game Pilot! Good luck, and have fun.

notes.title: Your Gemini Milestone is Here Pilots!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/9ae5c8803ec56521594093c5519d75dde949af49.jpg[/img]
[h1]Greetings Pilot![/h1]

[previewyoutube=npVOtQnAmCg;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re happy to report the Gemini milestone launch date has finally arrived!

The intent behind this milestone is to make things much easier and more accessible for new Pilots who are strapping in for the first time. For our veteran Pilots we've expanded gameplay, balanced weapons, and fixed almost 1,000 bugs.

New training and navigation tools should help beginner Pilots get up to fighting speed quickly. We’ve also introduced attractive new map variants and with a richer weapon set, which means we’re looking forward to hearing your insightful feedback.

[h3]Navigation : All New Mini Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/8312d4110e123f2b7b47b505c7b3aefd7efd4b62.jpg[/img]
Matt B has been working hard on core systems, but based on Pilot feedback he’s added a new navigation system to help you quickly determine where the nearest objectives or threats are located. This new system not only shows where friendlies and enemies are located, but now one can locate oneself in the space theater and aboard capital ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/b0eb142fd30d40818238720d0d4b7923d957d130.gif[/img]

[h3]AI Bots[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/27c0f4d28ad7a23530d8f984df82535732a53ba2.jpg[/img]
AI fighting AI. Artificial Intelligence is one of the core themes in Project Genesis lore, but now you can actually play against AI! These specialized AI have been developed by Anatoliy G. (AKA BubbleGum in [url=https://discord.gg/4X9rPC6]Discord[/url] and are only in their first iteration. Expect to see species of these units emerge as we move forward in our development timeline.

[h3]New Proteus Map Variant[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/cb1f7151653119c41112d3053c9b43d450e0a92d.jpg[/img]
For your gameplay viewing pleasure, Mark Nicolino has added a new Proteus snow map variant. Now you can experience the otherworldly views in a high contrast icy blue and white landscape.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/ffda1b4861adb0f6f72f875a49d98611b534be27.jpg[/img]
Our second pass using the new weapons system developed by Matt B and has been completed by Terry H. We’ve got a ton of work to do on the weapons so your input is crucial to helping us ensure solid play balance with the most lethal aspect of Project Genesis gameplay mechanics (besides accidentally crashing into asteroids).

[h3]Get Your Friends to Play for Free![/h3]
And last but not least, for the first time ever, we are making Steam’s Playtest option available to new players. You have probably seen our previous announce, but this feature is so cool we thought it bears repeating.

If you have friends who are on the fence about playing Project Genesis in these pre-alpha days, they can now take advantage of the playtest to get in on the action for free! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35175802/9cc4ad64b9b1f8a59ccd5e82280ab7a7be6d71b4.gif[/img]

To sign up, click Request Access on the Steam store page under Join The Project Genesis Playtest.  Watch Steam notifications and our social channels for more information on the playtest schedule and granted access.

notes.title: FORNAX II Milestone Achieved
notes.content:
We're back with another interim build update called FORNAX II as we ramp up for our next major milestone called GEMINI (planned for a late December release).

[h1]FORNAX II[/h1]
This build is intended to improve stability, provide additional notifications to help players know what's happening in a match, and tons of other gameplay improvements (most notably, making rounds feel faster and more engaging) which you can see in the "FORNAX II Change Log" section below.

[h1]LOOKING AHEAD[/h1]
We're moving on to the new year with some big additions with new and advanced features in the coming months that many of you have been asking for (weapons overhaul, new game modes, clearer progression paths, and bots!!). 

Thank you for your continued support in the development of Project Genesis!

[h2]FORNAX II Change Log[/h2]

- Redesigned Victory/Defeat Screen
- Redesigned Escape Menu - still working
- Fixed floating turrets in Enceladus
- Expanded level boundary in Enceladus to prevent premature triggering
- Added quit game confirmation
- Gameplay impactful ambient audio system with early samples in place
- Re-initiated mode map rotation within active sessions
- Fitted Hacker with a hood to go with her fancy cape
- Major gameplay award notification system with early notifications in place
- Merging groups of meshes in environments to help with draw calls
- LOD Optimizations - All Maps
- Audio: Fix to return MatchStart UI and SlideNotification alert audio
- Break stinger added to kill XP
- Upped resolution of KG Revolver color map
